---
title: LaTeX and PDF output
description: Produce academic glossaries and acronym lists with standard LaTeX packages.
---

## Academic defaults

The default configuration uses `glossaries-extra`, the portable `noidx`
backend, and the `long-short-desc` acronym style:

```yaml
glossary:
  latex-package: glossaries-extra
  latex-backend: noidx
  acronym-style: long-short-desc
  latex-location-lists: false
```

This gives first uses such as “application programming interface (API)” and
keeps a descriptive acronym list. Acronyms remain distinct from ordinary
glossary entries.

## Choose a backend

| Backend | Recommended use | Extra build command |
|---|---|---|
| `noidx` | Articles, reports, teaching material, portable projects | None |
| `makeindex` | Theses, books, established publisher toolchains | `makeglossaries` |
| `bib2gls` | Large or multilingual vocabularies; Unicode-aware sorting | `bib2gls` |
: LaTeX indexing backends. {#tbl-latex-backends}

`noidx` is the most reproducible default because an ordinary Quarto PDF render
is sufficient:

```bash
quarto render paper.qmd --to pdf
```

## Conventional indexed builds

For `makeindex`:

```bash
quarto render paper.qmd --to latex
lualatex paper.tex
makeglossaries paper
lualatex paper.tex
lualatex paper.tex
```

For `bib2gls`, the extension generates a portable glossary database beside the
LaTeX document:

```bash
quarto render paper.qmd --to latex
lualatex paper.tex
bib2gls paper
lualatex paper.tex
lualatex paper.tex
```

## Recommendations for academic writing

- Define an acronym only when its short form is used again.
- Supply explicit plurals when scholarly style or grammar differs from simply
  appending `s`.
- Keep the first-use form in prose even when the acronym also appears in an
  abstract, figure, or table; publisher rules often treat these regions
  independently.
- Leave location lists disabled for compact journal articles. Enable them for
  theses and books when readers benefit from page references or `see-also`
  relations.
- Use a stable `sort` value for symbols, capitalization variants, and
  multilingual vocabularies.
- Keep definitions concise and descriptive. Put argumentation and literature
  review in the main text, not in a glossary entry.

## Related entries

`see` and `see-also` become the `see` and `seealso` keys of each entry. An
entry that is only named by another entry's `see` or `see-also` is added to the
lists with `\glsadd`, so the cross-reference in the PDF has a target. With
`bib2gls`, the `recorded and deps` selection does the same.

## Document classes

The test renders use `article`, `report`, `memoir`, and `elsarticle`. A
journal class can restrict packages, so check your journal's template.

## Base package compatibility

Set `latex-package: glossaries` when a publisher forbids `glossaries-extra`.
The base package supports the primary term and acronym workflow, but
`see-also` intentionally requires `glossaries-extra`.
